houses.assets: Equities IN; duration underweight, front end preferred; up in credit quality. NFCI still loose.

quotes: The global macro environment provides solid support for cyclical assets—our base case scenario envisions resilient growth and robust earnings—even as central banks have shown that they are less willing to be accommodative.

agrees: Rates Tight: Goldman Sachs AM, Citi.
challenged: Rates is Tight. PIMCO says Neutral.
Growth is Mid. Citi says Strong; JPMorgan AM says Leaning strong.
Inflation is Leaning hot. PIMCO says Leaning cold.
Risk is Leaning risk-off. Citi says Risk-on; JPMorgan AM says Risk-on.
The long end is in. A house that will not own it is a challenge, not a match.

closest.name: Goldman Sachs AM
closest.clause: 1 of the five match. The card is still their note, not our score.

scorecard.falsifier: A cool inflation print that kills the next hike while stocks and the long end bid together — or a further jump in long yields that takes earnings with it.
